authorization: etymologise remaining Indo-Aryan surveys. do not rebuild. work autonomously and do what you can, you have 8 hours, i will review once your time is done.

proposals.evidence: Turner kīdṛśa explicitly gives Old Marwari kiso, Hindi kaisā, Punjabi kihā/kihṛā, Marathi kasā and related kis-/kas-/keh- type interrogatives. These survey forms fit that what-kind family, including local inflection and extensions. The extended -l-/-n- forms are qualified regional comparisons, not independent reconstructions of each suffix.

proposals.evidence: Turner kīdṛśa explicitly records Awankari kìā and Punjabi kihā of what sort, alongside Sindhi kĩa. The Bagri kiyā/kīyā responses with the same what-kind sense are compared with this northwestern qualitative interrogative; they are not automatically equated with Hindi kyā what under kim.
